name: UE5 TestFlight Pipeline Skill
title_zh: UE5 出包到 TestFlight 全自动流水线
tagline_zh: iOS/visionOS 构建、签名、上传、分发一条龙。你只改引擎版本，其余交给它。
tagline_en: Build, sign, upload, and distribute UE5 apps to TestFlight without touching Xcode. Saves 40 min per release cycle.
desc_en: Autonomous UE5 → TestFlight pipeline for iOS and visionOS
why_zh: 把 UE5 的打包脚本和 TestFlight 上传粘成闭环，连 visionOS 双平台都管。
why_en: Closes the loop between Unreal's build scripts and TestFlight upload, handling both iOS and visionOS. Parameterized config makes.
limit_zh: 只认 UE5 工程且本机已装 Xcode 和对应 SDK；不处理 App Store Connect 账号权限和证书申…
limit_en: Requires UE5 project, Xcode + SDKs installed. Won't manage Apple account permissions or cert creation. Stops at TestFlight external testing.
title_en: Automated UE5 to TestFlight pipeline for iOS & visionOS
